draft.emotion: steady and regular, counting the days of the routine
notes: Tuần primarily refers to a period of seven days. It is often combined with other words like 'tuần sau' (next week) or 'tuần trước' (last week).
In a formal or literary context, 'tuần' can also mean to patrol, but in daily life, it almost always means week.

examples.text: Tôi sẽ đi du lịch vào tuần tới.
examples.translation: I will go traveling next week.
examples.emotion: excited and looking forward to the upcoming holiday

senses.definition: An act of guarding or walking around an area to check for safety.

examples.text: Cảnh sát đi tuần ban đêm trên đường phố.
examples.translation: The police go on night patrol on the streets.
examples.emotion: vigilant and observant, keeping watch over the quiet streets
